width_definition: tau_j^t is the reduced multiplicity width for one total-spin j, not sum_j(2j+1)tau_j and not a total bond dimension. Same-layer nodes share W. The root has a final linear readout.
model: Physical Sz-configuration input; alternating horizontal/vertical binary CG merges; magnetic indices fixed, shared real W learned. Exact S=0 plus coherent translation/reflection/rotation projection.
paper_does_not_specify: exact number of SR warm steps
initialization: Paper: uniform W, sequential layer activation-std calibration on 1000 random configurations. This continuation preserves existing native optimized parameters instead; it does not redo this initializer.

author_code_search.claim: No verified public paper-specific implementation found; NetKet is acknowledged but is not the missing author architecture code.

interpretation: Exact paper-capacity architecture reproduction attempt, not a claim of author-identical training or achieved paper accuracy. From each saved same-H state, explicitly reset optimizer moments for a registered 16-step paper-like SR+Adam reentry, then 112 clipped-Adam steps. Parameters, physical state, chains, RNG and historical work remain traceable. No new head, attention or increased width.
